title: Dream journal app that auto generates ai images based on your description
content: Hey everybody, I see a lot of us using AI programs to generate images of our dreams and I just wanted to recommend this free app called "DreamKit". In addition to providing the basic dream journal/tracking utility, it also generates AI images for your dreams based on the description you provide. This is not a paid advertisement and I understand if this post gets removed. I just wanted to share a useful tool with the community. I love being able to look back on my dream journal and see my dreamscapes all in one place. Cheers!
